content:
The **Night Light** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

## Background[edit]

The Night Light was available as a reward for completing the "See The Light" weekly challenge in Survival mode from May 21–27, 2019 and August 13–20, 2019.
